question: Should maintainers schedule a signed macOS Darwin 27 visual repro for the native Open Chat inversion, or wait for more reporter-provided environment/proof details first?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose a code fix from source inspection because the screenshot proves a visual symptom but not the failing layer.

options.title: Run macOS 27 visual repro
options.body: Use a signed macOS app build on Darwin 27 to confirm the failure and identify the narrow host/layout/renderer fix path.

options.title: Wait for reporter refresh
options.body: Ask the reporter for a current-version screenshot or recording before spending maintainer validation time.

recommendation.title: Run macOS 27 visual repro
recommendation.body: Use a signed macOS app build on Darwin 27 to confirm the failure and identify the narrow host/layout/renderer fix path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal points to recent macOS/native Chat host work and adjacent shared Chat maintenance.
